body.space: a linear subspace of \(\mathbb R^{|\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}|}\)
body.def: Let \(A_{\Psi}\) have rows \(\alpha_j'\), \(j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\), and let \(L_{\mathrm{ASC}}=\operatorname{lin}(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}-p_0)\). Define \(\mathcal K_0=\{A_{\Psi}z:z\in L_{\mathrm{ASC}}\}\). A rational left-nullspace description is computed from the rational affine-hull equations of \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{ASC}}\).
body.role: exact compatibility relations for finite limiting offsets of causal observed-law sequences
